targets.source: Set by my personal trainer on 20 Nov 2026

cardio.type: Incline walk or cardio of choice

approach: Weigh in daily. The plan gets adjusted based on how weight moves.
Starting on fairly high calories, so eat whole foods as much as possible, but still eat the foods you enjoy.
Nobody's perfect. What matters is how you react after an off-plan meal: one bad meal won't ruin progress, but one bad day will.

trainingNote: Legs on Tuesday and Thursday, so make the next gym session upper body. Still to fit in this week: two 30–40 minute incline walks and 3–4 days of 10,000 steps.

notes: Final tally: about 3,325 kcal (~13,900 kJ), roughly 525 above the 2,800 target my PT set the next day (425 above the top of its ±100 range).
Fat was the big miss: about 148 g against 70–80 g. The nuggets (~50 g), chocolate (~43 g) and doughnuts (~22 g) make up most of it.
Protein: about 118 g, two-thirds of the 180 g target. Carbs landed a little over at ~370 g.
Chocolate: ~835 kcal, about 25% of the day, and ~77 g of the ~159 g of sugar.
Accuracy: the pho and doughnuts are ±150 kcal each, and the three dipping sauces are assumed to be sweet ones at ~50 kcal each.

callout.title: Takeaway
callout.text: Swapping just the chocolate for two protein yoghurts would have saved ~500 kcal and ~40 g of fat and added ~25 g of protein, landing the day right around 2,800.

notes: Breakfast: a caramel latte sachet with ~4 teaspoons of sugar and a splash of milk. Only ~155 kcal, but ~27 g of sugar and almost no protein (~2 g). The sachet is already sweetened, so the extra sugar more than doubles it.
Lunch: a footlong Sweet Onion Chicken Teriyaki on malted rye. About 720 kcal and ~50 g of protein with only ~10 g of fat. A strong pick.
Still to go: about 1,825–2,025 kcal, ~128 g of protein, ~160–200 g of carbs and ~57–67 g of fat.
Accuracy: the sachet's energy is from the box. Its macros, the sugar, the milk and the sub are estimates, and the sub is assumed to be a footlong.

callout.title: Rest of today
callout.text: Protein is the gap: ~128 g to go. Tuna this afternoon (~25 g), a big dinner built around ~250 g of cooked chicken breast or lean beef with rice and veg (~85 g), and a protein yoghurt or protein milk tonight (~25 g) covers it. There's plenty of energy left, so make dinner a proper meal. Eating well under 2,800 is off-plan too.
